title: MedlinePlus Connect Web Application Demonstration
content: Official websites use .gov A .gov website belongs to an official government organization in the United States. Secure .gov websites use HTTPS A lock ( Lock Locked padlock icon ) or https:// means you’ve safely connected to the .gov website. Share sensitive information only on official, secure websites. MedlinePlus Connect Web Application Demonstration Use this demo to see how the MedlinePlus Connect Web application responds to codes for diagnoses (problems), medications, lab tests, and procedures. Also see the MedlinePlus Connect Web service demonstration for responses in XML, JSON, or JSONP. The MedlinePlus Connect Web application conforms to the HL7 Context-Aware Knowledge Retrieval (Infobutton) Knowledge Request URL-Based Implementation specification . When you enter or select a code below, we show you the MedlinePlus Connect response as a Web page.
